headline: Hugo Thorvaldsen vaults to 26th on ARC-3

sections.text: Hugo Thorvaldsen gained 5.82 points to reach 35.49, climbing from 441st to 26th in the past day.
That puts Thorvaldsen within sight of the gold places, whose current cutoff is 18th. The public standings remain provisional ahead of the private medal board.
